But since I don't have any samples from the Dark Horror, my research is mostly on hold. Sometime soon, I may ask you to obtain some Dark Horror bones for me. (…

But I'm not sure how much a foreign race like yourself would understand about the ingredients used in black magic ... Yes, I think it would be best to ask someone from our race. (Ques…

Q00169_OffspringOfNightmares/30145-05.ht.text: Magister Vlasty: Hmm ... This is without a doubt the skull of a dark horror. But I cannot perform my spell with Cracked Skulls alone. Bring me an uncracked, whole skull. Then I will pay you for the Perfect Skull, along with any Cracked Skulls you may bring me.

Q00169_OffspringOfNightmares/30145-06.ht.text: Magister Vlasty: Ho, this is the whole, Perfect Skull of a dark horror ... Somehow, it looks similar to Elven skulls ... Hmmm ... interesting ...? Wait ...! It can't be ... Here, take the payment I have promised you. Now go away. Never speak of this again. You must promise me. Do you understand?

Q00169_OffspringOfNightmares/30145-04.ht.text: Magister Vlasty: Haven't you been able to obtain the skulls yet? Well, there's no need to rush. I repeat, to find the dark horrors, go to the swamp area that is southwest of the village. Slay the dark horrors and bring the skulls back to me. It doesn't matter if they are cracked. But you must bring…

Q00169_OffspringOfNightmares/30145-03.ht.text: Magister Vlasty: To find these dark horrors, you should go to the swamp area southwest of the village. But it may be hard to find a perfect, whole skull. In most cases, when a dark horror dies, the power of the black magic that supports its life is scattered, and the bones are shattered. So, it may…

But one day, they all just disappeared. After a long investigation, it was concluded that they had been slain by the Elves of light at that …

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30145-note.text: Magister Vlasty: I do not accept students other that those Mystics of the Dark Elves. There is someone else who will be able to teach you, but it is up to you to find who that is.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30145.html.text: Magister Vlasti: Darkness is the source of fear for the other races' Wizards, but that is shortsighted. They see only half the picture! I will teach you the ultimate power behind the darkness and the secret of the magic that lies hidden in the shadow.

You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!
